text:
Maria: hey team — sorry for the late ping. I'm stuck at the airport, flight delayed, and I can't make my overnight primary. I’m on the pager for the 00:00-08:00 UTC block. Need someone to pick up primary or shadow for at least the first 4 hours. :airplane:
AJ: ugh, sorry — i'm technically on PTO but i'm around for a couple hours if it's critical. can cover 00:00-02:00 UTC then gotta drop.
Maria: that helps. primary right now is me, secondary is AJ in roster but he’s limited. looking for a deputy to cover 02:00-08:00 UTC. customer impact note: EU customers saw a ~20m blip earlier with 502s on hosted endpoints, we did a quick rollback. logs/metrics in the runbook.
incident-bot: PAGERS: 2 open alerts (P1=0, P2=1, P3=1). Active alert: hosted-endpoints-eu 502 spike — incident created 1772466400. Incident channel: #incidents/1772466400
Leo: i can take 02:00-06:00 UTC if someone can shadow 06:00-08:00. have to be offline 06:00-07:00 for apac sync.
Sam: i can do 06:00-08:00 UTC. happy to take the last leg.
Maria: huge thanks Leo + Sam. AJ can hold 00:00-02:00. I'm handing off the running notes:
runbook-bot: quick links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ghost-shift-coverage — runbook v3.2. Key commands below.
runbook-bot: ```
# healthcheck list
curl -sS https://eu-api.redwood.company/health | jq .
# scale worker group
rctl scale workers --group=hosted-eu --replicas=6
# rollback model variant
rctl deploy rollback --service=hosted-eu-models --to=2026-03-12-rollback
```
Maria: copy paste of the incident play: 1) verify ingress LB healthy 2) check model worker OOM/events 3) scale group if queued requests > 200 for 5m 4) if errors persist, rollback to previous variant and open canary fallback.
Leo: question — do we have automatic fallback to the smaller quantized variant for hosted-eu? i remember routing policy was set to fallback-to-quant-q3 last month.
Maria: yes — smart routing has a fallback but it's rate-limited to avoid cost spikes. steps to trigger manual fallback are in the runbook (search for FALLBACK_TRIGGERS).
AJ: just confirming: i'm available 00:00-02:00 but offline after. i'll add a note to the schedule and mark myself as shadow for those two hours. :white_check_mark:
Sam: taking 06:00-08:00 — i'll create a small handoff note in the runbook and a bridge link in case the customer ops team wants to join.
Maria: can someone post the bridge URL here? i don't have laptop in airport lounge.
Leo: creating bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/1772468101 — pinned in calendar; i'll add it to the incident.
incident-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window at 02:30-03:00 UTC in ap-northeast; consider routing around region if mitigation overlaps.
Maria: important — if mitigation requires scaling across regions, prefer eu->us fallback, not apac. we want to avoid triggering the apac maintenance window.
Sam: ack. i'll monitor logs and set an alert threshold for queued requests > 150 (5m) and post here if it trends up.
Leo: quick sanity check: runbook step 3 says to check KV cache hit ratio. low hit ratio -> cold starts and request pileup. run `metrics query --m=kv_hit_rate --range=10m --s=hosted-eu`
Maria: thanks — i'm handing off full responsibility to Leo for 02:00-06:00 UTC and Sam for 06:00-08:00 UTC. AJ covers 00:00-02:00 UTC. i'm reachable by DM but won't be primary. :wave:
AJ: will also drop a short checklist in the oncall doc with escalation numbers.
Sam: noted — leaving a quick step list in the runbook: scale, check routing, rollback, open bridge.
Leo: i'll update the incident summary and mark the new primary/secondary in pagerduty.
Maria: appreciate you all — please post any customer-facing impact messages if we see repeat errors. i'll follow up tomorrow morning with a retro. :thumbsup:
Sam: done. i added a short status update to #customers saying 'we're observing elevated errors in EU endpoints, mitigation in progress; ETA ~2h'.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: hosted-endpoints-eu - mitigation in progress. next auto-check at 1772471700.
Leo: copying final handoff: primary=AJ (00-02), deputy=Leo (02-06), deputy2=Sam (06-08). listing runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ghost-shift-coverage. good luck all.
Maria: thanks team — off to gate. :airplane:
